Class EditorActivityListener

java.lang.Object
comp3607project.EditorActivityListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.editor.DocumentListener
public class EditorActivityListener extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.editor.DocumentListener
Receives BlueJ editor document changes and records text-change events, including active and idle editing intervals.

This documentation is generated from a separate copy of the submitted source. The original project source files are not modified.
